name: Levi's
trk: Measuring sales: sales are currently tracked through Rakuten links. Installing the Lemrock Conversion Tracker is essential to measure the campaign's real ROI and optimise delivery on conversions, not just clicks.
interp: with 29% fewer impressions, the campaign generated 46% more clicks and doubled its CTR: delivery is now focused on shoppers who are genuinely looking for denim and Levi's pieces.
req: Which Levi's jeans for a relaxed fit?
Straight-leg or wide-leg jeans, what's the difference?
How should a pair of 501 jeans fit?
Which high-rise jeans make the legs look longer?
How does a Levi's Trucker jacket age over time?

ins.t: Vintage and heritage pieces drive clicks
ins.c: The Vintage Red Tab T-shirt reaches 1.84 times the average CTR, the Trucker jacket 1.38 times and the Vintage Boxy sweatshirt 1.31 times.
ins.so: Shoppers come to Levi's for its heritage: it is the brand's strongest differentiator.
ins.a: We will increase the share of vintage and heritage pieces in delivery.

ins.t: Jeans remain the core of the campaign
ins.c: Men's jeans reach 1.13 times the average and women's jeans 1.05 times; the XL Straight jean reaches 1.28 times.
ins.so: Relaxed and straight fits match what shoppers ask AI assistants about.
ins.a: We will focus jeans ads on relaxed and straight fits.

ins.t: Accessories work best as a complement
ins.c: Belts, beanies and caps stay at 0.49 times the average when shown on their own.
ins.so: Accessories are bought alongside a main piece, not as a first purchase.
ins.a: We will reduce standalone accessory ads and show them as a complement to jeans.

ins.t: Outerwear is the next growth lever
ins.c: Jackets and sweats reach 1.24 times the average, skirts and dresses 1.20 times.
ins.so: With the cold season starting, outerwear is the category with the most potential.
ins.a: We will push outerwear (Trucker, sherpa, sweats) through October and November.
